_meta.description: Amazon Ads Sponsored Brands per customer search term per day (Reporting v3 sbSearchTerm). Retired: v3 report collection stopped for every store on 2026-11-20; Ads data from 2026-09-01 is in v_ads_search_term_daily (ad_product = 'Sponsored Brands'), and this table is deleted on 2026-12-31.
_meta.retention_note: rows older than 400 days are pruned nightly (newest snapshot per store never pruned where applicable); query beyond the window returns a report_date_note
_meta.dedup_note: 2026-07-15 calibration: 56-64% of rows were duplicates (NULL target_id in a NULLS-DISTINCT unique key defeated upsert dedup). Constraint rebuilt NULLS NOT DISTINCT + history deduped keeping the latest ingest per key. SUM aggregates computed before this date were inflated.
caveats: For any day from 2026-09-01 read v_ads_search_term_daily with ad_product = 'Sponsored Brands'; use this table only for days before 2026-09-01, until it is deleted on 2026-12-31. Split a range at 2026-09-01 and never add the two: the same Ads data is in both.

Columns there: search_term as named (Stream's '(Other)' row holds what Amazon names no term for), keyword → keyword_text, match_type as named, keyword_id / target_id → target_id (its expression in v_ads_target_daily); campaign and ad group names from rpt_ads_campaigns / rpt_ads_ad_groups. cost → total_cost; impressions, clicks, purchases, sales, units_sold, purchases_promoted, sales_promoted, detail_page_views, add_to_cart, viewable_impressions and new_to_brand_purchases / _sales / _units_sold / _detail_page_views as named; every *_clicks column → *_from_clicks; video_complete_views → complete_views_video_ad, video_first_quartile_views → first_quartile_video_ad, video_midpoint_views → midpoint_video_ad, video_third_quartile_views → third_quartile_video_ad, video_5_second_views → five_second_views_video_ad, video_unmutes → unmutes_video_ad. Both are 14-day attribution. Rates, percentages and e_cp_* are not stored: compute them from the sums (new_to_brand_units_sold_percentage = new_to_brand_units_sold / units_sold). currency_code → currency.
Its rows stop on 2026-11-20, when v3 collection ended for every store (its schedules read superseded_by_stream): its newest day is not the newest Ads data.

columns.note: Marketplace this ads row belongs to. Query ads data per (store, country_code) directly — no need to reverse-map profile_id.
Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.

Row ingest timestamp (UTC). Bookkeeping, not business data. UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
JSON of Amazon columns with no dedicated DB column (unmapped/new headers land here).
